versions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: approved-style concept comparison sheet for SpaceTrader planetary ORBITAL SHIPYARD RINGS, five build stages. Input 1 is the SAME PLANET reference: retain its green coastlines, sandstone aqueducts and terracotta settlements unchanged across ALL five panels. Input 2 is STYLE / INDUSTRIAL CONSTRUCTION reference: match cream/teal painted spacecraft shipyards, brass machinery, orange cranes, warm amber task lights, dark ink outlines and detailed mature European sci-fi comic brushwork. NOT photorealistic, NOT thin geometric line rings.
Wide landscape concept sheet with FIVE separated panels: 3 top, 2 centered bottom, dark navy backdrop. Every panel contains the entire SAME planet with orbital structures shown in elevated three-quarter view. Planet diameter same across every panel. Each industrial ring is a physical inclined ellipse surrounding the planet: rear arc passes BEHIND planet, front arc in FRONT of lower portion. No poles or pedestals to ground, no blue atmosphere border. Keep most planet surface visible and full ring silhouettes inside each panel with margins. Rings must be MUCH THICKER and more massive than Saturn rings: boxed pressure-vessel segments, heavy trusses, pipelines, tank farms, freight depots and open drydock hangars, creamed worn armor and teal patches, believable detailed modular industrial silhouette.
Five German captions and states, exact reading order:
1 GEBROCHENER RING: a damaged incomplete small ring orbit with a few old broken industrial arc sections and missing modules, dark inactive windows, no outer ring.
2 KLEINER WERFTRING: one COMPLETE sturdy compact ring at about 1.5 planet radii, thick mechanical segments, 2 small construction cradles and orange crane gantries, warm inhabited engineering. No outer ring.
3 GROSSRING – ABSCHNITT 1: retain that complete inner ring. Outside it at about 2.3 planet radii add exactly a HALF-CIRCLE of massive NEW ring segments, clearly open at two exposed girder ends, temporary scaffolding and cranes. The other outer half is empty space. Clear visible incomplete stage.
4 GROSSER WERFTRING: retain inner ring and complete the outer heavy ring at same radius as stage 3. Much more industrial volume, numerous freight pods, radiator panels and one principal large open shipbuilding cradle. Only TWO concentric physical rings.
5 DOPPELWERFT: SAME inner and outer ring radii and same basic configuration as stage 4, but TWO EQUAL enormous shipbuilding cradles attached on opposite sides of outer ring, each containing a small partly built hull, heavier logistics modules and twin crane complexes. Only TWO concentric rings, do not add third ring. Strongest industrial silhouette.
No UI, no unrelated ships or space scenery, no labels other than five stage captions. Consistent planet and perspective across sequence. The main purpose is big chunky comic industrial orbital shipyard architecture, not glowing circles. Prefer 3072x2048.

EDIT this five-stage concept sheet in response to specific user feedback: the rings are MUCH TOO BULKY and too tightly packed against the planet. Redesign the proportions ONLY, retain the lovely hand-painted inked cream/teal/brass sci-fi comic style, same five states and SAME green ruins planet.
CRITICAL: make every ring's structural band about FIFTY TO SIXTY percent THINNER than input, reduce module bulk similarly. Create a LARGE CLEAR DARK SPACE GAP between planet limb and nearest ring: at the left and right sides, EMPTY GAP is at least 30 percent of the planet's DIAMETER. The small ring's overall outer diameter should be about TWO TIMES the planet diameter, while its band thickness is only about 5 percent of planet diameter. For the big two-ring system the INNER ring keeps these proportions, OUTER ring diameter about 2.8 planet diameters, with another LARGE OPEN DARK GAP between the two rings. Both rings are slender but convincingly industrial modular segmented metal structures, not hairline or glowing circles. Show 75 percent EMPTY SPACE across the ring system's footprint: the engineering is graceful, open, airy, well-separated, not a dense solid cage or bowl. Planet is clearly visible, rings never hug its equator or touch the surface. Inclined orbital planes, ring rear parts behind globe and foreground arc well below/in front, enough inclination/clearance to see DARK SPACE separating the structure and the globe.
Maintain five panels, 3 top and 2 bottom, dark navy; SAME globe in all. Captions and stages: GEBROCHENER RING (few broken slim sections); KLEINER WERFTRING (complete slim industrial inner ring, 2 compact service docks); GROSSRING – ABSCHNITT 1 (inner ring plus HALF of outer ring, rest open, no extra partial ring); GROSSER WERFTRING (two complete well separated slim rings and ONE modest attached large shipbuilding cradle); DOPPELWERFT (same two slim rings, TWO modest cradles on opposite sides, NOT more ring mass). Keep cranes and docks localized, small, and readable. NO thick fortress walls, NO third ring, NO large continuous hangar boxes, NO blue planet halo. Generous full-object margins, clear uncluttered silhouettes. Prioritize RADICAL reduction of bulk and generous dark gaps, not just tiny changes.
